title: F-h relation derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must derive the linear relationship F = 20h - 100 using energy conservation and Newton's second law at point B.

title: Graph intercept a
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the vertical intercept a = -100 N from the derived F-h relation.

title: Graph slope b
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the slope b = 20 N/m from the derived F-h relation.

title: Collision analysis
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply both momentum conservation and kinetic energy conservation for the elastic collision between P and Q.

title: Variable friction work
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly integrate the work done by the position-dependent friction force on Q over distance L.

title: Energy conservation for h
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply energy conservation from release height h to the pre-collision speed of P at A.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Optional Criteria: The response may discuss the physical meaning of negative F values (block losing contact) in the F-h graph.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student writes F - mg = mv²/r instead of F + mg = mv²/r for the normal force at the top of the circle.

title: Friction work miscalculation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student uses average friction force instead of integrating μ(x) = 2x/5 over the distance.
